content: Context compression tools face critical trade-offs between extractive compaction (keeping verbatim spans) and abstractive summarization (lossy rewriting). The chief failure modes are Semantic Drift—where key details like negations, specific thresholds, and formatting rules are summarized away—and Reference Breakage. Abstractive summarizers frequently erase exact values (paths, error messages, identifiers), making them useless for debugging and agent artifact tracking.
